verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's proxy issues virtual keys with per-key spend tracking and individual spending limits, configured with max_budget and budget_duration. That covers the budget half of giving an agent its own capped key. The rate-guardrail half is only shown as an rpm_limit on a team object, not documented for an individual key. Missing for 10: documented per-key rpm/tpm rate limits, evidence that a key is hard-blocked once its budget is exhausted, any agent-specific key guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can give an autonomous agent its own key with budget and rate guardrails so it cannot run away on spend

citations.quote: Personal budgets: Create virtual keys without team_id for individual spending limits
Track Spend, and control model access via virtual keys for the proxy
max_budget: 0 # (float) sets max budget as $0 USD  budget_duration: 30d # (str) frequency of reset
